convert_benchmark_json_to_csv: run bm2bq.py with a google-benchmark JSON file to convert it to CSV for BigQuery upload
print_bigquery_schema: run bm2bq.py with the --schema flag to print the BigQuery table schema
expand_benchmark_json: use bm_json.expand_json to expand benchmark JSON data with an optional comparison JSON file
sanitize_values_for_bigquery: use the SANITIZE mapping to cast row values to their BigQuery SQL types
review_bm2bq_cli: review the bm2bq.py script that converts google-benchmark JSON output to BigQuery-compatible CSV
